title: External validation of Epic Sepsis Model
decision_impact: Alerts could influence clinician attention and timing of antibiotics
verified_facts: A peer-reviewed external validation evaluated 38455 hospitalizations and reported poor discrimination and calibration.
reported_harm: Missed sepsis and high alert volume could delay care or create alert fatigue
quantitative_evidence: The model missed 1709 of 2552 sepsis cases while alerting on 6971 of 38455 hospitalizations at the studied threshold.
limitations: Retrospective data from one health system and one model configuration do not prove the same outcome for CareGuide VN.

title: Emergency symptom-checker triage comparison
system_purpose: Provide diagnosis and urgency recommendations from patient information
decision_impact: Unsafe triage could direct an emergency patient away from timely care
verified_facts: Researchers compared four systems with clinical data and independent emergency-physician review.
reported_harm: Unsafe under-triage could delay emergency assessment and treatment
quantitative_evidence: Unsafe triage was 14% for Ada 41% for ChatGPT 3.5 22% for ChatGPT 4.0 and 19% for WebMD across 37 triage cases.
limitations: The sample was small and evaluated historical public systems rather than this proposed grounded assistant.

title: LLM clinical decision support in Kenyan primary care
system_purpose: Assist clinicians with documentation and clinical management suggestions
decision_impact: Clinicians could adopt beneficial or actively harmful recommendations
verified_facts: A retrospective physician-panel review covered 1469 encounters from 16 clinics during a 2024 deployment.
reported_harm: Harmful advice could be copied into documentation and influence treatment while over-reliance weakens review
quantitative_evidence: Reviewers identified actively harmful recommendations in 115 encounters and 67 remained in final documentation.
limitations: The study concerns a specific Kenya deployment and retrospective review; causal patient outcomes and Vietnam generalizability are limited.
